_doc: Backend↔frontend parity registry (F0.1). The checker fails on NEW backend routes that have no UI and aren't listed here, on stale entries (fixed but still listed), and on frontend calls that hit no backend route. Paths are normalized: params → ':p', no trailing slash, no query. Keys are 'METHOD /path' or a bare '/path' prefix for uiNone/proxy entries (prefix match).

uiNone._doc: Backend routes that legitimately never get a UI control: agent/SDK ingestion, webhooks, health, and internal service-to-service or control-plane endpoints. Prefix match (a listed path covers itself and anything under it).
uiNone.POST /api/v1/logs: log ingestion (agents/SDKs, not a UI action)
uiNone.POST /api/v1/agent/playbook/execute: internal: topology agent executes a signed playbook
uiNone.POST /api/v1/topology/catalog: agent registers services into the catalog
uiNone.DELETE /api/v1/topology/tenant: internal: gateway purger fans out tenant deletion to topology-service (driven by /admin/tenant/purge-data, not a direct UI call)
uiNone.POST /api/v1/slo/evaluate-pr: CI/PR shift-left gate caller, not a screen

proxyUpstreams._doc: Gateway prefixes reverse-proxied to non-Go upstreams (Pyroscope/Quickwit/Jaeger/etc). Frontend calls under these prefixes are 'covered' even with no Go HandleFunc. Prefix match.

knownOrphans._doc: Backend routes that SHOULD have a UI but don't yet — the Wave 2 backlog, frozen as known debt. The checker ALLOWS these but the list may only shrink: ship the UI, delete the entry. Adding a NEW orphan not listed here fails the build. Each maps to its ROAD_TO_100 feature.

frontendExternal._doc: Frontend /api paths that intentionally don't map to a gateway route (Next.js internal API routes, etc). Empty today.
